name: "Carrot Cake" Oatmeal with Dates & Walnuts
instructions: Place water and salt in a medium saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and peel carrots; coarsely grate.
Once the water is boiling, stir in carrots, dates, oats, and spices. Reduce heat to low, cover, and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until oatmeal reaches desired consistency, 3-5 minutes.
While the oatmeal cooks, roughly chop walnuts.
Divide oatmeal between bowls; top with walnuts and sprinkle with sugar. Serve with milk and enjoy!
author: Mealime
